rule: Priority is a property of the issue type, not of the reviewer's convenience. An item carrying several issue types takes the highest priority among them.

classes.definition: the record cannot enter a headline aggregation unit until it is decided
the record can be aggregated but its interpretation is contested
provenance or metadata completeness, not an analytic decision

human_review_scope: Only canonical items whose human_review_requirement is 'required' are placed in the curation queue. Items already resolved by evidence adjudication are shipped as context, not as work.
